title: Sing Pal
style: ASMR singing, wet food sounds, experimental, soft, experimental
lyrics:
[Chorus]
Sing
Pal
Sing it back to me
Sing
Pal
Sing it back to me

[Verse]
As the apple bites
So does the worm
It digs down to the core
A slippery slope
But it's good to the bone
You can't help but want more
And you know what you're in for

[Pre-Chorus]
When you eat
Don't talk with your mouth full
Don't speak
Use your teeth
All I wanna hear is the sound of you chewing
So speak through your food
I wanna hear you chewing
Oh

[Chorus]
Sing
Pal
Sing it back to me
Sing
Pal
Sing it back to me
Sing
Pal
Sing it back to me
Sing
Pal
Sing it back to me
